name: Z123 swap burns pool liquidity
summary: Z123's custom sell router, a token minter, called Z123.update() on every sell to burn the sold amount from the Z123/USDT pair and sync it, raising the price for the next sell. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker bought Z123 and sold it back in 80 small router sells, each burning pair Z123, draining the pair's USDT; copycats repeated it.
notes: The reset is the owner's setToken on the unverified router pointing its burn target (slot 0x4) from the Z123 token to the pair; replaying the anchor with the old value reverts, and the router had no other activity since 2023. The token's minter grant to the router is older.

Campaign: the three later txs that ran repeated router sells against the pair (two by bot 0x7edaf26b, one by 0x6dc72be9). Loss is the pair's gross USDT depletion across the four; the Z123 burned from the pair is the same liquidity. A same-block 473k USDT in/out at block 38126001 is a bot round trip.
